functions.name: codespaces
functions.description: Canonical Codespace instances across organization, organization-member, repository and authenticated-user scopes. Codespace owner is distinct from repository owner and billable owner. Machine capacity describes the configured machine and is not running utilization or billing consumption. Nullable machines and the API-declared Unknown state remain observable; undeclared state values fail pinned-schema validation. Repository relationship uses returned repository identity, without parsing incidental URLs.

configured_codespace_cpu_count.comment: Sum of configured machine cores, not utilization.

functions.name: codespace_machine_options
functions.description: Machine eligibility observations qualified by repository or Codespace context and machine name. Query inputs preserve location, ref and client-IP provenance; capacity is an offered configuration, not an allocated resource. Repository and Codespace availability may differ and must not be deduplicated by machine name alone.

metrics.comment: Eligible machine configurations in the selected contexts.

metrics.name: ready_prebuild_machine_option_count
metrics.comment: Machine options reporting a ready prebuild.

offered_codespace_cpu_count.comment: Sum of offered cores across options, not allocated machine cores.
